title: Zephyr: Schnorr48 verify
notes:
Already implemented
Verified complete without edits. Core schnorr48_verify enforces exact 48-byte signatures, rejects NULL/nonzero messages, invalid/low-order keys, zero response scalars, non-canonical s via Monocypher recover_r, and uses crypto_verify16 for constant-time challenge equality without mutating caller buffers. Canonical C corpus covers six valid signatures plus wrong message/key, tampered challenge/response, 47-byte signature, all-zero signature, identity/8-torsion pubkeys, s=L, and zero-s. Validation: fresh UBSan C ctest 1/1 and schnorr48_test 9/9; clean LINK-v1/SIID interop C ctest 1/1 (all six independent PyNaCl signatures); Python Schnorr + signed-frame tests 40 passed; Rust schnorr48_vectors 2/2 and shared_vectors 6/6 passed. Scoped mtimes unchanged; no files modified by this leaf.
close_reason: Verified strict Appendix-A and cross-language Schnorr48 verification
